card.name: Words just before rations, doses, amounts
card.fires_on: Words that come right before an amount or quantity term such as rations, doses, milligrams, fold or times the limit. It fires on the early part of a split word (mill-, reduc-ed) or on a small word before the quantity.

modes.label: Start of milligram/milliliter
modes.description: The first piece of milligrams or milliliters right after a number or 'from milligrams to'.
modes.example: (g) of fat, 33 g of protein, 30 g of carbohydrate, 8 g of fiber and 370<< mill>>igrams of sodium.

modes.label: Before dose or fold amounts
modes.description: A word or number in a label phrase that leads into doses, fold increases or meals.
modes.example: BE MONITORED CAREFULLY; PATIENTS WITH RENAL IMPAIRMENT AND/OR NITROGEN RETENTION SHOULD RECEIVE REDUC<<ED>> DOSES.

modes.label: Food supply wording
modes.description: Adjectives before food, rations or provisioning in general prose about meals or scarcity.
